briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 escalate multi-agent AGI benchmarks amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while prompt injection attacks surge in production systems. Global compute buildout intensifies as nations race for AGI dominance.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with 4.2T parameters; xAI releases Grok-4; DeepSeek-V4 claims cost leadership. Meta open-sources Llama-4-405B sparking immediate forks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins next month.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units; Microsoft and Google announce 50GW data center expansions. TSMC reports record AI chip yields.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols outpace centralized safety frameworks by 2027?
